rationale: B has the richer art direction: a layered dusk landscape with a rising moon behind the phone, sunrise illustrations in the feature cards, gradient lilac-to-peach CTAs and a glowing 'Tonight can be different' finale, where A stays a more uniform gold-on-navy with long stretches of similar dark panels. A's pinned 'One night, in order' clock sequence (21:30 to 05:59) is the stronger single piece of scroll storytelling, but some of its scroll frames show empty card shells and a sparse, half-filled viewport, and its mobile capture at ~9234px has a large blank band at the top. Both heroes use comparable masked headline reveals with the phone mockup settling in by about 1.3 s, and both hover sets are tasteful but modest (A has an underline and a CTA glow; B has a pill highlight and a soft glow), so the decision rests on B's more distinctive visuals and cleaner mobile.
